verdict.rationale: Sierra documents built-in AI assistants that users hand tasks to. Ghostwriter builds or modifies agents, including workflows, integrations, guardrails and tone, from plain prompts or uploaded SOPs, transcripts and audio. Explorer answers natural-language questions across conversations and sends proactive weekly briefings. Agent Studio can generate journeys from existing procedures with AI. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Ghostwriter/Explorer, detailed docs on the assistant's task scope, review/approval of AI-made changes, and limitations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Build or modify agents by describing how you want them to behave. Update workflows, systems integrations, guardrails, tone, and style with simple prompts.
Upload SOPs, raw transcripts, or even audio interviews of subject matter experts to create customer journeys from scratch.
Ask any question about your customer experience in natural language, and Explorer identifies the answer across thousands of real conversations.
Explorer automatically delivers a weekly briefing on key trends, emerging issues, and recommendations — without you having to ask.
use AI to instantly generate journeys from your existing operating procedures
